title: Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground
assumptions: Source is the local rfe-snapshot.md (Jira unreachable); the strategy section's scope (input only, one file per conversation, no mic, no PDF, no audio output) overrides the broader RFE text.
Routes are separate HTML files (/index.html, /ai-assets.html) since the prototype is static.
Model switcher reloads with a scenario rather than live-updating; the 500ms AC is simulated.
Persona ids ai-engineer and ai-admin are inferred, not checked against the persona catalog.
10 MB limit is the proposed default pending PM confirmation.
